code_improvements.title: Add Keyboard Shortcuts for Task Operations
code_improvements.description: Extend the existing keyboard shortcut pattern from the sidebar navigation to Kanban board task operations. Add shortcuts for common actions like opening task details (Enter), closing dialogs (Escape), marking tasks done (D), and moving to backlog (B).
code_improvements.rationale: The Sidebar component already has a well-established keyboard shortcuts pattern with the 'shortcut' property on navigation items (K for Kanban, A for Terminals, etc.). This pattern can be directly extended to task operations in the KanbanBoard component without architectural changes.
existing_patterns: App.tsx useEffect keyboard listener for project switching
code_improvements.implementation_approach: 1. Add useEffect keyboard listener in KanbanBoard for focused task shortcuts. 2. Track selected/focused task state. 3. Map key events to existing updateTaskStatus and selectTask actions from task-store. 4. Follow the same pattern as App.tsx global keyboard handling.

code_improvements.title: Add Task Export to JSON/CSV
code_improvements.description: Add export functionality for tasks in the Kanban board, allowing users to download their task list with all metadata in JSON or CSV format for backup or external tool integration.
code_improvements.rationale: All task data structures are already defined in shared/types/task.ts with comprehensive Task type. The task-store provides getTasksByStatus selector. The only missing piece is the download trigger, which is a trivial browser API call using Blob and URL.createObjectURL.
code_improvements.implementation_approach: 1. Add exportTasks utility function to lib/utils.ts that serializes tasks to JSON/CSV string. 2. Add export button in KanbanBoard header with dropdown for format selection. 3. Use Blob and URL.createObjectURL for download trigger.

code_improvements.title: Add Task Filters to Kanban Board
code_improvements.description: Add filtering capabilities to the Kanban board following the established ChangelogFilters pattern. Allow filtering tasks by creation date range, text search across title/description, and review reason.
code_improvements.rationale: ChangelogFilters.tsx demonstrates a mature filter UI pattern with RadioGroup selections, date inputs, and Select dropdowns. The KanbanBoard already has tasks as props and uses useMemo for processing - adding filter logic fits naturally into this flow.
existing_patterns: ChangelogFilters.tsx filter state management and UI structure
useMemo for derived task lists in KanbanBoard
Input component for search, Select for dropdowns
code_improvements.implementation_approach: 1. Add filter state (search term, date range, reviewReason filter) to KanbanBoard. 2. Create compact filter bar component inspired by ChangelogFilters sidebar pattern. 3. Apply filters in useMemo before column grouping using existing task properties. 4. Use existing Input, Select, Checkbox UI components.

code_improvements.title: Add Bulk Task Selection and Operations
code_improvements.description: Enable multi-select functionality for tasks in the Kanban board to perform bulk operations like moving multiple tasks to a different status, archiving, or deleting.
code_improvements.rationale: The Archive All button for Done column already demonstrates the bulk operation pattern. Checkbox component exists in ui/checkbox.tsx. The archiveTasks function in task-store shows multi-task operations are supported. This extends existing patterns to user-selectable scope.
builds_upon: Archive All button pattern in Done column
existing_patterns: Archive All button onClick handler in DroppableColumn
code_improvements.implementation_approach: 1. Add selectedTaskIds state to KanbanBoard. 2. Add checkbox to TaskCard (conditionally rendered based on selection mode toggle). 3. Add bulk action toolbar that appears when tasks selected. 4. Extend task-store with bulkUpdateTaskStatus action following archiveTasks pattern.

code_improvements.title: Add New Agent Tool Category for Task Analytics
code_improvements.description: Extend the backend tool registry to include task analytics tools that can provide insights on task completion rates, average time in each status, and bottleneck identification.
code_improvements.rationale: The tool registry pattern in agents/tools_pkg/registry.py shows a clean modular approach with create_*_tools factory functions (create_subtask_tools, create_progress_tools, create_qa_tools, create_memory_tools). Adding an analytics category follows the established factory pattern exactly.
existing_patterns: Tool function signature pattern with spec_dir and project_dir params
Tool return format from existing tool implementations
code_improvements.implementation_approach: 1. Create new tools/analytics.py following tools/progress.py structure. 2. Add create_analytics_tools(spec_dir, project_dir) factory function. 3. Register in registry.py create_all_tools by adding all_tools.extend(create_analytics_tools(...)). 4. Implement get_task_metrics and get_completion_trends tools.
